pitch_theses.name: Governed AI Infrastructure
pitch_theses.hook: DIO is governed AI execution infrastructure: one inspectable orchestration layer that can compose products while preserving proof, refusal and human authority.

pitch_theses.name: Product Factory / Venture Studio OS
pitch_theses.hook: DIO turns shared governed capabilities into repeatable product incarnations, making the investment thesis the factory and its declining marginal cost of creating the next evidence-bound product.

pitch_theses.name: Vertical SaaS Portfolio
pitch_theses.hook: DIO already expresses the same governed organism through multiple vertical workflow products, creating several commercial wedges without rebuilding the intelligence stack each time.

pitch_theses.name: Evidence-first RegTech / Trust
pitch_theses.hook: DIO makes consequential AI work inspectable by binding claims, evidence, prerequisites and refusals into governed execution receipts rather than treating trust as a policy paragraph.

pitch_theses.name: Education Wedge into Governed AI
pitch_theses.hook: HOMS provides a concrete education wedge into DIO: assessment and learning workflows demonstrate how one governed architecture can become domain-specific without surrendering educator authority.

pitch_theses.name: Emerging-market AI Infrastructure
pitch_theses.hook: DIO is being built from South African workflow realities outward: governed AI infrastructure that can serve education, evidence and professional-service markets locally while remaining composition-driven globally.

fallback_pitch_thesis.name: Governed Product Organism
fallback_pitch_thesis.hook: DIO is a governed product-generation organism whose value lies in reusable intelligence, evidence and execution infrastructure rather than any single application.
